title: QMT IPO configuration

execution_start_date.description: Earliest authorized subscription day in Asia/Shanghai; queries remain available before activation.

notification_mode.description: Owner-authorized address deferral: keep durable notifications without HTTP delivery or failed-attempt counters.

task_prefix.description: Immutable task namespace for this installation; omitted legacy value is QmtIPO3.

transport.description: Explicit route; no automatic fallback after failure.

native_bridge_dir.description: Dedicated installation/native spool; never shared with another broker or the order ledger.

qmt_userdata.description: Explicit existing userdata_mini or userdata IPC directory; UI edition never selects or switches it automatically.

description: Documentation schema. runtime.validate_config additionally enforces absolute paths and local recovery guards. Secrets are never stored directly in this JSON.
